project_internal_directory_aliases.note: Frozen source_path checks source canonical target remains within project and regular allowlisted small-file children. It intentionally permits reused project-internal collection aliases and parent state_data aliases. No sourcefile symlink, outside-project canonical target or model/raw payload was found.

optional_absent_objective_csv.note: The finite allowlist only adds an optional basename if it exists. All eight required per-family/phase CSVs and PNGs are present; four DP objective-loss CSVs also present. Backend objective CSV is not separately required.

reviewer_conclusion: Pass for exact existing frozen21 export policy and current dry inventory. No source/binding/runtime modification is required. Root scientific result review and apply-time full SHA checks remain required.
payload_policy: Only two exact metadata JSONs may traverse caches; no model/HDF5/RNG/video/log/JSONL/raw-feature file is in inventory.
limits: Dry records unregistered source bytes/size only; apply still hashes every file, adds bounded MANIFEST/README and reruns the unchanged gates. No main outcome values interpreted by this review.
